scope: New Mini hand-tracking gesture slice; distinct from PR229/PR231 messaging and Pixel fixture reviews. Read-only source review with isolated independent tests.

resolvedFindings.counterexample: Resolve the camera permission promise, then stop two microtasks later. The fulfillment had passed its alive check, but its later await assignment stored the stream after stop. Session was idle with stops=0 and lateStreamStored=true.
resolvedFindings.fix: Await into a local stream, recheck generation, stop that local stream on stale generation, and assign shared session state only while alive.
resolvedFindings.finalIndependentVerification: Six microtask placements all close the track exactly once and leave stream/srcObject null.

resolvedFindings.counterexample: Save the running worker error handler, stop and restart the CameraSession, then invoke the old handler. It stopped the new session.
resolvedFindings.fix: Bind the running error callback to alive(gen), matching the frame callback.
resolvedFindings.finalIndependentVerification: Old error and frame callbacks cannot change the running new session, current video attachment or consumer frame count.

resolvedFindings.counterexample: With maxDurationMs=100, send at time 10 then deliver a worker result at time 100 before the next animation callback. The expired session stayed running and delivered one consumer update.
resolvedFindings.fix: Validate response-time clock and session expiry before invoking the consumer.
resolvedFindings.finalIndependentVerification: At/after expiry and nonfinite/regressed clocks, no consumer update occurs and capture is stopped.
